name: fr_cc_search
description: Search decisions of the French Constitutional Council (Conseil constitutionnel) by French free text, e.g. "données personnelles", "liberté d'expression", "droit de grève". Returns decision number and kind (DC = review of a law, QPC = priority question of constitutionality, L, LP, ELEC, RIP and others), date, the title the Council gives (parties and subject), the normalised outcome (e.g. "Conformité - réserve", "Non conformité partielle") and the id for fr_cc_get. Optional date_from / date_to (ISO). Results are ranked by the Council's own search; 10 per page.

query.description: French free text, e.g. "données personnelles", "principe de fraternité".

date_from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; decisions on or after.

date_to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; decisions on or before.

name: fr_cc_get
description: Fetch one Conseil constitutionnel decision by id (from fr_cc_search, e.g. "2023/20231052QPC"): number, kind, date, title, normalised outcome, the full French decision text paged with max_chars/offset, and the link to the Council's PDF.

id.description: Decision id from fr_cc_search: year/number-and-kind, e.g. "2023/20231052QPC", "2004/2004499DC".
